premises: Independent original-coordinate input densities satisfy 0<=f_i<=1 and integrate to one.
For each iid copy-pair, F_i(d,u)=int f_i(x)f_i(x-d)exp(iu(2x-d))dx retains the full sum/difference dependence.
Plancherel gives intint |F_i|^2 = pi (int f_i^2)^2 <= pi.
The Brascamp-Lieb theorem is applied only when the explicitly defined phase-space BL constant is finite; finiteness is not inferred from s3(A)>=1.
Conditioning outside an original-coordinate principal block preserves independence and cap-one laws inside that block and creates only affine terms.

main_result.name: QFORM-PHASESPACE-MOYAL-BL-v1
main_result.statement: For Q=x^TAx+b^Tx+c on m independent cap-one variables, define L_i d=(d_i,(Ad)_i) and Bph(A)=BL((L_i); exponents 1/2). Then |phi_Q(t)|^2 <= pi^(m/2) Bph(A)|t|^(-m/2). If m>=5 and Bph(A)<infinity, Q has a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||inf <= [m/(m-4)] Bph(A)^(2/m), and int |t|^-1/2 |phi_Q(t)|^2 dt <= [4m/(m-1)]sqrt(pi) Bph(A)^(1/m). The same bound applies via conditioning to any original-coordinate principal block of size m>=5.

exact_geometric_branch.statement: If A=cU with U real symmetric orthogonal and zero diagonal, Bph(cU)=|c|^(-m/2). For m=6 and U=[[0,I3],[I3,0]], ||p_Q||inf<=3/|c| and the density is continuous C0.

partner_result_applied.application: On the star-plus-rank-one-bank family A_m(a,b), r35's Bph is infinite by the BL dimension condition, while the partner grouped theorem gives ||p_Q||inf <= 3*4^(2/3)|a|^(-2/3)|b|^(-1/3) <= 7.5595262994 and the weighted whole-copy time integral <=13.5052565160 at |a|,|b|>=1.

unresolved_implication: From only s3(A)>=1, route product-preservingly either to an original-coordinate block of size at least five with uniformly controlled phase-space BL constant, or use any BL dimension defect to extract a quantitatively paid grouped-hub/low-rank-carrier/ridge/pivot mechanism. This exhaustive structural routing is not proved.
